methods.label: Use corresponding intercepts
methods.explanation: When three parallel lines intersect two lines, the corresponding segments are proportional: \(AB/BC=DE/EF\), or \(3/6=4/EF\). Therefore, \(EF=8\).
methods.levelReason: The method directly uses the Grade 9 theorem for parallel lines cutting two transversals.
